Write 2^n − 1 in binary: n ones. Grouping into base-four digits from the right, each pair of bits gives digit 3.

If n is even, n/2 digits all equal to 3, so the sum is 3n/2. Setting 3n/2 = 2023 gives n = 4046/3, which is not an integer.

If n is odd, there are (n−1)/2 digits equal to 3 and a leading digit 1, so the sum is 3(n−1)/2 + 1. Setting this equal to 2023 gives 3(n−1)/2 = 2022, so n−1 = 1348 and n = 1349.

Check: 1349 is odd, and 3·674 + 1 = 2023. ✓

ANSWER: 1349
